title: Catéchisme de la doctrine chrétienne, publié par ordre de S. S. le Pape Pie X, traduction française autorisée
publisherImprint: Paris, Imprimerie Paul Feron-Vrau, 5 rue Bayard
authorization: Letter from Cardinal Merry del Val to Emmanuel Bailly dated 7 March 1913
printPhysicalOriginalProvenance: Digitized scan bearing historic title/authorization and printed pagination; no independent physical-copy provenance certification
collationPolicy: Page-verified evidence only; full 433 pages not yet signed off. The 1912 Italian transcription is not itself a 1912 photographed original.

verifiedPageSamples.claim: 1913 French witness restricts nuptial Mass with special blessing from Advent to Epiphany and the start of Lent to the octave of Easter.
verifiedPageSamples.comparison: Italian 1912 transcription Q226 instead names first Sunday of Advent to Christmas and Ash Wednesday to Easter Sunday.

verifiedPageSamples.claim: Printed French distinguishes acquired natural virtues from supernatural virtues bestowed by God.
verifiedPageSamples.comparison: A later online French rendition truncates this distinction; unsafe as a canonical French import.

verifiedPageSamples.claim: Printed French names religion and four cardinal virtues: prudence, justice, fortitude, temperance.
verifiedPageSamples.comparison: The damaged online French rendering omits the list.

verifiedPageSamples.claim: Printed French lists minor orders, subdiaconate, diaconate, priesthood and episcopate in its 1912-era hierarchical description.
verifiedPageSamples.comparison: The damaged online French rendering omits the named grades; modern sacramental/disciplinary distinctions remain in supplemental teaching.
